title: 第23章 坏了是魔族第24章 魔族再临
slug: 魔法我钢铁洪流直接平推
lines: 过了许久，李秘书轻声开口。
“领导？”
“嗯，发给另外四位吧。”赵老的声音有些干涩。
他抬手擦了擦眼角湿润，沿着安全通道的指示牌，走出了会议室。
大夏，也许还有希望......
李秘书在平板上快速操作，小跑着跟上。
“领导，贝尔基地那边，赵刚同志有新汇报。”
“他说，通过改良精灵的弓箭，我们的外交取得了重大突破。”
赵老接过平板，一边走一边看，等他反应过来，人已经站在自己办公室门口了。
他推门而入，脸上再也绷不住，放声大笑。
“好！好！好！这个赵刚，真不亏是我的定心丸！”
“这个口子找得太准了！既能给精灵族送去急需的战斗力，又能提升波好感，顺便还能保障林默同志的安全，一箭三雕！”
“等这层关系稳固了，我们就可以找机会，聊聊那个世界树的事了。”
李秘书扶了扶眼镜，有些疑惑。
“领导，为什么不趁热打铁？”
“现在他们最需要我们，直接用更先进的武器技术，交换世界树的种子，成功率应该不低。”
赵老摇了摇头，把平板放在桌上。
“小李啊，你换位思考，世界树对于精灵族，是什么？”
“是家，是信仰，是他们种族的根！”
“如果现在有个外星人，说要用武器技术，换咱们的赖以生存的家园，你会怎么想？”
李秘书愣住了，
“我会....我立刻拒绝，并且警惕防备对方。”
赵老拍了拍他的肩膀。
“就是这个理。”
“所以，饭要一口一口吃，急了，就会烫嘴。”
林默此刻正在泰拉大陆，化身双界通勤打工人。
利用大夏智囊团连肝出的方案，给精灵们带来了计量工具的图纸和一套堪称简陋的标准化生产流程sop。
然后，整个精灵营地就跟打了鸡血一样，陷入了狂热的生产浪潮。
林默翘着二郎腿，手里正把玩着一把刚下线的连弩。
他熟练地拆开弹匣，检查里面的卡榫。
又对着阳光眯起眼，看了看弩臂那近乎完美的直线度。
content_en:
After a long time, Secretary Li spoke softly.
"Leader?"
"Well, give it to the other four." Mr. Zhao's voice was dry.
He raised his hand to wipe the moisture from the corners of his eyes, followed the signs for the safe passage, and walked out of the conference room.
Daxia, maybe there is still hope...
Secretary Li quickly operated on the tablet and trotted to keep up.
"Leader, over at Bell Base, Comrade Zhao Gang has a new report."
"He said that by improving the elven bows and arrows, we achieved a major breakthrough in diplomacy."
Mr. Zhao took the tablet and looked at it as he walked. When he reacted, he was already standing at the door of his office.
He pushed open the door and walked in. His face could no longer be tense and he laughed loudly.
"Okay! Okay! Okay! This Zhao Gang is really my reassurance!"
"This opening is so accurate! It can not only provide the elves with much-needed combat power, but also improve Bo's goodwill. It can also ensure the safety of Comrade Lin Mo, killing three birds with one stone!"
"When this relationship is solid, we can find opportunities to talk about the World Tree."
Secretary Li adjusted his glasses, a little confused.
"Leader, why don't you strike while the iron is hot?"
"Now they need us the most. If we directly exchange more advanced weapon technology for the seeds of the World Tree, the success rate should be high."
Mr. Zhao shook his head and put the tablet on the table.
"Xiao Li, if you think about it from my perspective, what does the World Tree mean to the elves?"
"It's family, faith, and the root of their race!"
"What would you think if there were an alien now who wanted to use weapons technology to replace our homeland that we depend on for survival?"
Secretary Li was stunned.
"I will...I will refuse immediately and be wary of the other party."
Mr. Zhao patted his shoulder.
"That's the truth."
"So, you have to eat your food one bite at a time. If you are in a hurry, you will burn your mouth."
...
Lin Mo is currently in the Terra Continent, transforming into a dual-world commuting worker.
Using the plans proposed by Daxia's think tank, the elves were given drawings of measuring tools and a set of rudimentary standardized production processes SOP.
Then, the entire elf camp was plunged into a frenzied production wave as if it had been given a shot of chicken blood.
Lin Mo crossed his legs and was playing with a repeating crossbow that had just come off the assembly line.
He deftly disassembled the magazine and inspected the latches inside.
He squinted at the sun again and looked at the almost perfect straightness of the crossbow arm.
